notes.title: Drift Stage - Steam Trading Cards - Community Content Update.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32853835/9680d70743e76b017437a5784791aeadfa10fdca.png[/img]
Welcome to the 2024 "Big Kahuna" Community Content Update. 

A big opportunity.

Big trades, big numbers, big rarity.

Now available, with every copy of Drift Stage - to all current Steam Key holders:

Seven Drift Stage Official "Steam Trading Cards" to collect, with a chance at a rare "foil" variation of any of the base version cards.

With drops occurring at steady 30 minute intervals, any time spent this summer running hot laps on your favorite track; or working in the "Decal Editor" - will reward drivers with a chance at one card.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32853835/cde2b174000ddddb101d02b5b09c4466fc877c38.png[/img]

Unique to "Drift Stage" Steam Trading Cards, the seventh and final card in the First Edition set features a Special Edition - Holographic treatment and set number designation.

Also included in this release are additional profile backgrounds, emoticons, and a series of unique badges - featuring the one thing all "Drift Stage" players covet the most: mesh racing wheels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32853835/8f4f516df6e951c20dd2d27a203479c9df430810.png[/img]

Upgrade your level 1 Steelies into 5 variations, with one separate ultra-rare "Foil" variation - or trade your haul for a background or emoticon.

All content features new, original artwork, created specifically for this release. No re-used marketing renders here.

Its a big deal. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32853835/2f5ba8b65c124d3bfcbb8e40f2e621154701d54e.png[/img]

notes.title: Drift Stage - Post Steam Launch Overview.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32853835/4f884062ea40cc8b45ebf0c60342d80590402d99.png[/img]
[h2]Drift Stage. Steam Early Access Launch, 2023 Review.[/h2]

Welcome to the Summer 2024 "Drift Stage" overview. The nature of this announcement serves as a follow-up and update on the development status of Drift Stage, and as well as a preamble for the announced "Steam Community Content" update.

The mixture of circumstances and previous delays; combined with a demand far exceeding the capacity of "Super Systems" as a studio - made for a very unpredictable and challenging launch.

Despite the necessity for an unannounced, unadvertised release - in January of 2023, Drift Stage's reception and interest far exceeded any internal predictions or metrics. 

[b]For the first time since 2016, Drift Stage's Early Access release announcement saw engagements of over 100K people. [/b]That's more than any trailer, demo build, or soundtrack release since the original video that launched the project in 2014.

[h2]2023 Publishing Talks & Reception.[/h2]

[h3]If you are interested in publishing "Drift Stage", contact "Super Systems Processing" via our listed e-mail address at:
"[url=https://help.steampowered.com/en/wizard/HelpWithGameTechnicalIssue?appid=349470]Drift Stage: Steam Support Page[/url]"[/h3]


One of the main goals of this delayed "Early Access" release - somewhat of a contradiction in itself; was, and continues to be - seeking a publisher to pick-up development and bring the resources required to complete Drift Stage, and bring the Steam version to a releasable state - where the fundamental issues of production funding and lack of a marketable "game" vs. a unfinished prototype - are solved.

Talks stemming from January of 2023, all the way through to November of 2023 - almost met these goals - and the final decision not to move forward was due to the same issues that lead "Drift Stage" to such a delayed and rocky development - since 2019.

A signature required on a document - allowing for the legal transfer of the games Source code, to the interested publisher - could not be obtained; not without undue effort - and not in time to fit the game into the time window required.

This process was time consuming, resource intensive, and costly; and should have - under any other circumstance - allowed for "Drift Stage" to be acquired and finished by a professional team - with a budget. 

[b]With that stated - the document issue has been dealt with - and any future publishing opportunities can move forward.
[/b]

[h2]2024 - Steam Community Content Update.[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32853835/7bb81b8b78161a89e97d725410467d82fa6f2c46.png[/img]

In the interest of providing new content, and requested features while new software updates or publishing opportunities are not available; "Super Systems Softworks" has prepared a set of "Steam Trading Cards" and their accompanying "Community Features".

Series "Zero" contains seven unique trading cards, with the chance to unlock Profile Backgrounds, Steam Chat Emoticons, and Profile Badges - each with their own rarity and drop rate.

Please look forward to an announcement [very soon]; as this fresh content has just been cleared for release. 

[h2]New Official Drift Stage Website and URL.[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32853835/917cfeca27c55bbcaea21fe09735efe00928d7d3.png[/img]

Drift Stage's website has been relaunched, compromising of a new platform specifically built for Drift Stage. This user focused design acts as an archive and central hub for Drift Stage's previous demo builds - media assets - and videos.

Potential for development of new updates and expansions on this platform will continue into 2024.

[h3][url=https://driftstageofficial.com/]https://driftstageofficial.com/[/url][/h3]


[h2]Outstanding questions, new customers - a new era.[/h2]

To clarify any confusion regarding Drift Stage's development status, this testing build of "Drift Stage" was left unreleased since late 2019 - due to internal conflicts with Drift Stage's only programmer leaving the project unannounced. These same problems prevented the aforementioned publishing agreement in 2023 from finalizing. I apologies for the continued issues with the original development team. Their actions towards Drift Stage are out of my hands and have contributed to years of set-backs for the project as a whole, and operating "Super Systems" as a studio.

With that stated, and already known by most of Drift Stage's fans and player-base - I would like to move on to the current and relevant topics of this project - as any updates to the current version of Drift Stage is dependent on acquiring a publishing deal - with the resources to finish and maintain the project and IP - or hiring a skilled programmer, willing to put in the effort to independently finish and deliver Drift Stage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32853835/cb5923166215f4469fdc5f5d04204a79c5a55b81.png[/img]

notes.title: Drift Stage - Community Content Updates & Test Phase
notes.content:
[b]In preparation for a public release of "Drift Stage" version 0.4.1192.4641, multiple changes have been made to the "Drift Stage" Store, Library, Community, and DLC pages. [/b]

Notice of updates:

[b]01/10/2023[/b]

[list]
[*] A three page quick reference manual is now accessible via the "Drift Stage" store page (.pdf).
[*] All placeholder assets and default layout images, avatars, logos, screenshots, text, and icons have been updated or replaced with new content - meeting current Steam feature and guideline standards.
[*] Migration of bare-bones DLC based soundtrack package to full Steam support with corresponding page and available formats + high resolution cover art. If you already have the soundtrack as part of your key bundle - you will automatically own the migrated soundtrack.
[*] Addition of five(5) exclusive Steam avatars - available in your "Profile Settings" under "Your Avatars".
[*] Incorrectly configured Steamworks settings were preventing Steamworks content from loading into the game. This has been fixed, allowing all community skins to load directly into the car select menu.
[/list]


This has been a test of the public announcement system. 

Thank you for your attention.

- Super Systems Management
